findings.highlight: The same swords, the same techniques clash.
findings.evidenceJa: 同じ剣、同じ剣戟が交差する。
findings.governingReading: The same swords and the same sword blows cross.
findings.explanation: Concrete crossing sword strikes become the broader category “techniques.”

findings.highlight: my body is wounded
findings.evidenceJa: 体は深手を負っていく。
findings.governingReading: my body sustains deep wounds
findings.explanation: The progressively deep severity of Shirou’s wounds is omitted.

findings.highlight: his weapon sweeps at me from the side.
findings.evidenceJa: 凶器は横殴りに俺の体を一閃した。
findings.governingReading: the weapon slashes horizontally across my body.
findings.explanation: An attack that actually cuts Shirou’s body becomes a sweep merely directed at him.

findings.highlight: the wound will eventually overcome me.
findings.evidenceJa: 確実に肉を断ち
findings.governingReading: certainly cuts through flesh
findings.explanation: The immediate, certain severing of flesh is omitted.

findings.highlight: the wound will eventually overcome me.
findings.evidenceJa: いずれ致命傷となるだろう。
findings.governingReading: will eventually become fatal
findings.explanation: A clear medical progression to a fatal wound becomes the unnatural “overcome me.”

findings.highlight: swing Bakuya at the close enemy
findings.evidenceJa: 踏み込んだ敵に右の莫耶を叩き落とす
findings.governingReading: bring the right-hand Bakuya crashing down on the advancing enemy
findings.explanation: The downward, forceful counterstroke against an advancing Archer is generalized to swinging at a nearby enemy.

findings.highlight: Your assumptions of the basic structure are still too weak.
findings.evidenceJa: 基本骨子の想定が甘い。
findings.governingReading: Your conception of the basic structural frame is still naive or insufficiently rigorous.
findings.explanation: Archer criticizes the rigor of Shirou’s structural conception; “assumptions … too weak” is malformed and vague.

findings.highlight: My temple and my side.
findings.evidenceJa: 眉間と横腹。
findings.governingReading: Between my brows and across my flank.
findings.explanation: The first simultaneous vital target is moved from the center of Shirou’s forehead to his temple.

findings.highlight: My head hurts to the point of blurring my sight.
findings.evidenceJa: 眼球が痺れるほどの頭痛。
findings.governingReading: A headache so fierce that my eyeballs go numb.
findings.explanation: A grotesque bodily sensation is replaced by blurred vision.

findings.highlight: threatens to drive me mad
findings.evidenceJa: この体を狂わせていく
findings.governingReading: drives this body out of alignment or order
findings.explanation: Physical breakdown is changed into mental insanity.

findings.highlight: slash at his body.
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツの体を袈裟に薙ぐ。
findings.governingReading: slash diagonally across his body.
findings.explanation: The exact diagonal sword stroke is omitted.

findings.highlight: my body breaks every time we touch each other.
findings.evidenceJa: 触れあう度に体がズレる。
findings.governingReading: each contact throws my body further out of alignment.
findings.explanation: A recurring displacement between the two existences becomes generic bodily breaking.

findings.highlight: perfected over many years of training.
findings.evidenceJa: 長い年月の末に得た
findings.governingReading: obtained at the end of long years
findings.explanation: The English specifies training as the sole source of Archer’s accumulated combat method.

findings.highlight: I allowed myself to learn too much about my future self.
findings.evidenceJa: 本来知ってはいけない未来の自分を知ってしまった。
findings.governingReading: I ended up knowing the future self I was never meant to know.
findings.explanation: Unwanted, transgressive knowledge becomes something Shirou allowed himself to acquire.

findings.highlight: the burning wound in my stomach
findings.evidenceJa: 裂かれた腹の焼き鏝めいた重さ
findings.governingReading: the branding-iron-like weight in my torn abdomen
findings.explanation: The torn abdomen and oppressive branding-iron weight are reduced to a generic burning wound.

findings.highlight: He swings them down in a cross.
findings.evidenceJa: 十字に交差するように、俺の脳天へと振り下ろした。
findings.governingReading: He brings them down toward the crown of my head in a crossing X.
findings.explanation: The exact lethal target at Shirou’s crown is omitted.

findings.highlight: My body becomes numb as if a hammer had been smashed on it
findings.evidenceJa: 体は金槌を打ちこまれたように痺れ
findings.governingReading: My body goes numb as though a hammer had been driven into it.
findings.explanation: The penetrating shock image becomes an awkward external hammer blow.

findings.highlight: vanity.
findings.evidenceJa: 自己愛。
findings.governingReading: self-love or narcissism.
findings.explanation: Self-directed love is replaced by vanity, changing the psychological category.

findings.highlight: I am the bone of my sword.
findings.evidenceJa: 体は、剣で出来ている。
findings.governingReading: The body is made of swords.
findings.explanation: The active Japanese proposition about the body’s material composition is replaced by a different chant’s first-person bone metaphor.

findings.highlight: He did not show grief or pain.
findings.evidenceJa: 嘆く事もなく、傷つく素振りも見せないのなら。
findings.governingReading: if he neither lamented nor showed any sign of being hurt.
findings.explanation: A suspended condition in Archer’s remembered logic becomes a categorical summary of his conduct.

findings.highlight: fire is my blood.
findings.evidenceJa: 血潮は鉄で
findings.governingReading: The blood is iron.
findings.explanation: The blood’s iron composition is replaced by fire.

findings.highlight: Steel is my body
findings.evidenceJa: 心は硝子。
findings.governingReading: The heart is glass.
findings.explanation: The fragile glass heart disappears and is replaced by a claim that the body is steel.

findings.highlight: I have created over a thousand blades.
findings.evidenceJa: 幾たびの戦場を越えて不敗。
findings.governingReading: Undefeated after crossing countless battlefields.
findings.explanation: A history of undefeated passage through battlefields becomes a count of created weapons.

findings.highlight: Unknown to Death.
findings.evidenceJa: ただの一度も敗走はなく、
findings.governingReading: Not once did he flee in defeat.
findings.explanation: The absolute absence of retreat is replaced by an unrelated statement about death.

findings.highlight: Nor known to Life.
findings.evidenceJa: ただの一度も理解されない。
findings.governingReading: Not once was he understood.
findings.explanation: Archer’s lifelong lack of human understanding is replaced by an unrelated statement about life.

findings.highlight: Have withstood pain to create many weapons.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼の者は常に独り剣の丘で勝利に酔う。
findings.governingReading: He is always alone on the hill of swords, intoxicated by victory.
findings.explanation: Solitude, the hill of swords, and intoxication with victory are replaced wholesale by enduring pain to create weapons.

findings.highlight: See, this is your end.
findings.evidenceJa:
見ろこれがヤツの末路。
見ろこれが貴様の結末だ。
findings.governingReading: Look: this is his end. Look: this is your conclusion.
findings.explanation: The parallel distinction between Archer’s end and Shirou’s conclusion collapses into a single second-person line.

findings.highlight: My mind gives in.
findings.evidenceJa: 心が、折れる。
findings.governingReading: My heart breaks.
findings.explanation: Emotional breaking becomes intellectual surrender, obscuring the later contrast between defeated heart and resisting body.

findings.highlight: Yet, those hands will never hold anything.
findings.evidenceJa: 故に、その生涯に意味はなく。
findings.governingReading: Thus, that life had no meaning.
findings.explanation: A verdict on the meaninglessness of Archer’s entire life is replaced by a different chant’s empty-hands image.

findings.highlight: A horn-like sword
findings.evidenceJa: 双剣ではない、尖った角のような剣
findings.governingReading: Not the twin swords, but a blade like a pointed horn
findings.explanation: The explicit weapon change away from Kanshou and Bakuya is omitted.

findings.highlight: the twin swords I quickly projected.
findings.evidenceJa: 咄嗟に複製したヤツの剣。
findings.governingReading: his sword, copied on the spur of the moment.
findings.explanation: A singular newly copied horn-like blade becomes the familiar twin swords.

findings.highlight: “HaHaa, haa, haa, ha!”
findings.evidenceJa: 「ははあ、はあ、はあ、は！」
findings.governingReading: “Ha—haa, haa, haa, ha!”
findings.explanation: The breath sounds are visibly fused into “HaHaa.”

findings.highlight: Whatwas I seeing?
findings.evidenceJa: 今、何を見ていた、のか。
findings.governingReading: What was I just seeing?
findings.explanation: Missing spacing fuses the interrogative phrase.

findings.highlight: magic that lets you acquire skills from the past
findings.evidenceJa: かつての技術を修得する魔術
findings.governingReading: magecraft by which one acquires former skills
findings.explanation: The technical category is generalized to magic.

findings.highlight: that nasty face of yours
findings.evidenceJa: 今にも吐きそうな最低の面がまえ
findings.governingReading: that wretched expression, as though you might vomit at any moment
findings.explanation: Physical nausea and a catastrophically sick expression become Archer calling Shirou’s face nasty.

findings.highlight:
Don’t let me say it.
Don’t let me recall it.
findings.evidenceJa:
言わせるな。
思い出させるな。
findings.governingReading: Do not make me say it. Do not make me remember it.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s demand that Archer not force the memory into speech becomes a plea about permitting himself.

findings.highlight: His red cloak moves.
findings.evidenceJa: 赤い外套が翻る。
findings.governingReading: The red cloak whips or flares around.
findings.explanation: The violent visual motion accompanying Archer’s charge is flattened.

findings.highlight: Durandal, the renowned sword of the king
findings.evidenceJa: 覇者の剣と称される絶世の名剣
findings.governingReading: Durandal, the peerless famed blade called the sword of the conqueror.
findings.explanation: The conqueror title is weakened to king, and the sword’s peerless quality is omitted.

findings.highlight: I skip about four steps
findings.evidenceJa: 行程を四節跳ばし
findings.governingReading: I omit four stages of the process
findings.explanation: An exact technical omission of four projection stages becomes an approximate number of physical-sounding steps.

findings.highlight: I already know
findings.evidenceJa: 気が付かなかっただけで
findings.governingReading: I simply had not noticed
findings.explanation: Shirou’s new realization of his dying bodily state is reversed into prior knowledge.

findings.highlight: Do you understand that those are your true identity?
findings.evidenceJa: それが自身の正体だと理解したか
findings.governingReading: Do you understand that this is your true nature?
findings.explanation: The English leaves a number-disagreement error in Archer’s culminating accusation.

findings.highlight: so deep that I can reach inside them and take out my bones.
findings.evidenceJa: 指を埋められそうに深い
findings.governingReading: so deep that a finger could almost be buried in them
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents Shirou reaching into his wounds and removing bones.

findings.highlight: take out my bones. them.
findings.evidenceJa: 指を埋められそうに深いのには、正直、まいった。
findings.governingReading: Their finger-burying depth is honestly overwhelming.
findings.explanation: The invented bone-removal sentence is followed by the stray word “them.”

findings.highlight: My mind bluffs itself, saying that it has not given in.
findings.evidenceJa: 折れかかった心が、まだ折れていないと強がっている。
findings.governingReading: My nearly broken heart bluffs that it has not broken yet.
findings.explanation: The heart’s near fracture becomes an intellectual mind giving in, weakening the body-versus-heart structure.

findings.highlight: I focus the last of my will on the Magic Circuit.
findings.evidenceJa: 残った意識を、全て回路につぎ込み回す。
findings.governingReading: I pour all my remaining consciousness into the circuit and drive it.
findings.explanation: Remaining consciousness and active operation of the circuit become willpower and focus.

findings.highlight: My split nerves scream.
findings.evidenceJa: ささくれ立った神経が悲鳴をあげる。
findings.governingReading: My frayed, splintering nerves scream.
findings.explanation: The splintered-fraying texture is reduced to nerves being split.

findings.highlight: I carefully put together the eight steps.
findings.evidenceJa: 動揺する事なく八節を組み上げる。
findings.governingReading: Without wavering, I assemble all eight stages.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s lack of emotional disturbance under pain becomes mere carefulness.

findings.highlight: “Trace, off.”
findings.evidenceJa: 「投影、完了」
findings.governingReading: “Projection, complete.”
findings.explanation: mirror moon reverses completion of Projection into the command to turn tracing off.

findings.highlight: He does not parry my attacks, but pushes them back.
findings.evidenceJa: 受け流せず、ヤツの双剣とこちらの双剣が鍔迫り合う。
findings.governingReading: Unable to parry it aside, his twin swords lock against mine at the guards.
findings.explanation: The momentary blade lock is collapsed into Archer already pushing the attack back.

findings.highlight: Hehthen let me ask you, Shirou.
findings.evidenceJa: ふんでは訊くがな士郎。
findings.governingReading: Hmph. Then let me ask you, Shirou.
findings.explanation: Missing punctuation fuses Archer’s snort with the next word.

findings.highlight: Do you really want to be a superhero?
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方になりたいと思っているのか？
findings.governingReading: Do you truly want to become an ally of justice?
findings.explanation: The work’s central ideal-name is again replaced by “superhero.”

findings.highlight: WhatI
findings.evidenceJa: 何を、今更
findings.governingReading: What—at this point
findings.explanation: Missing punctuation fuses Shirou’s startled response.

findings.highlight: I don’t want to become one. I’m going to become one
findings.evidenceJa: 俺はなりたいんじゃなくて、絶対になるんだよ
findings.governingReading: It is not merely that I want to become one—I absolutely will.
findings.explanation: Shirou rejects framing his resolve as a wish; the English instead says he does not want the ideal at all.

findings.highlight: An emotion you can neither betray nor deny.
findings.evidenceJa: 逆らう事も否定する事もできない感情。
findings.governingReading: An emotion you can neither resist nor deny.
findings.explanation: Inability to oppose an implanted drive becomes a moral inability to betray it.

findings.highlight: Even if that wish is not born from within you.
findings.evidenceJa: 例えそれが、自身の裡から、表れた物でないとしても
findings.governingReading: Even if that emotion did not arise from within you.
findings.explanation: The sole compulsive emotion under discussion becomes a wish.

findings.highlight: Emiya Shirou’s foundation will crumble.
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎の基盤は跡形もなく崩壊すると。
findings.governingReading: Emiya Shirou’s foundation will collapse without leaving a trace.
findings.explanation: The total annihilation of Shirou’s psychological foundation is weakened.

findings.highlight: But stillI know that I must know.
findings.evidenceJa: それでも知らなければならない
findings.governingReading: But still, I know that I must know.
findings.explanation: Missing spacing fuses “still” and “I.”

findings.highlight: what is wrong with me, and how I am distorted.
findings.evidenceJa: 何を間違えて、何が歪だったのか
findings.governingReading: what he got wrong, and what exactly was distorted.
findings.explanation: Questions about Shirou’s error and distortion become a categorical claim that he himself is wrong and distorted.

findings.highlight: Is what I thought was beautiful.
findings.evidenceJa: なんて、幸せそうなのだろうと。
findings.governingReading: How happy he looked.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s perception of Kiritsugu’s happiness is replaced by an aesthetic judgment of beauty.

findings.highlight: if that fire was Kiritsugu’s fault
findings.evidenceJa: もし仮に、あの火災の原因が切嗣にもあるとしたら
findings.governingReading: if, hypothetically, Kiritsugu too bore some connection to the cause of that fire
findings.explanation: A counterfactual possibility of involvement becomes direct fault.

findings.highlight: Kiritsugu, the one who caused it
findings.evidenceJa: 当事者である切嗣は
findings.governingReading: Kiritsugu, a party directly involved in it
findings.explanation: Participation in the catastrophe is promoted into sole causation.

findings.highlight: a surviving child that could not be saved.
findings.evidenceJa: 助かる筈のない子供
findings.governingReading: a child who should never have survived
findings.explanation: The miraculous fact of Shirou’s survival is rendered as a contradiction in which the found child still cannot be saved.

findings.highlight: Emiya Kiritsugu saved a boy who had nothing.
findings.evidenceJa: 十分すぎるぐらい、衛宮切嗣は救ってくれた
findings.governingReading: Kiritsugu saved the empty self more than fully enough.
findings.explanation: The intensity and sufficiency of Kiritsugu’s emotional rescue are omitted.

findings.highlight: It would have been fine if you just admired what Emiya Kiritsugu wanted to become.
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮切嗣に、衛宮切嗣がなりたかった物に憧れるだけなら良かった。
findings.governingReading: It would have been fine merely to admire both Kiritsugu himself and what he wished to become.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s admiration of Kiritsugu as a person is omitted, leaving only the abstract ideal.

findings.highlight: I’ll make your dream…
findings.evidenceJa: “じいさんの夢は、俺が”
findings.governingReading: “The old man’s dream—I will…”
findings.explanation: The inherited-dream fragment changes grammatical subject and prematurely supplies “make come true.”

findings.highlight: had to become a superhero.
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方にならなくてはならなくなった。
findings.governingReading: became compelled to become an ally of justice.
findings.explanation: The central ideal-name is again replaced by “superhero.”

findings.highlight: For his sake, I simply tried to become what he had admired since he was small.
findings.evidenceJa: 幼いころから憧れ続けた者の為に、憧れ続けた物になろうとしただけ。
findings.governingReading: For the sake of the person I had admired since childhood, I merely tried to become the thing I had always admired.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s lifelong admiration is reassigned to what Kiritsugu admired as a child.

findings.highlight: resist my mind that is about to give in.
findings.evidenceJa: 折れていく心を支える。
findings.governingReading: support my heart as it breaks.
findings.explanation: The ongoing fracture of Shirou’s heart becomes a mind capitulating.

findings.highlight: Over and over, you said you wanted to help people.
findings.evidenceJa: 誰かの為になると。そう繰り返し続けたおまえの想い
findings.governingReading: Your conviction, repeated over and over, that you would be of use to someone.
findings.explanation: A repeated self-definition through service becomes reported speech about wanting to help people generally.

findings.highlight: The sword I made using all my remaining power
findings.evidenceJa: 残った全精力で作り上げた干将も
findings.governingReading: Even Kanshou, made with all my remaining strength
findings.explanation: The specific surviving sword and continuity of the paired blades are omitted.

findings.highlight: I’m dead. I’m on the verge of death from the first blow.
findings.evidenceJa:
やられた。
初撃で既に瀕死。
findings.governingReading: He got me. The first blow has already left me mortally wounded.
findings.explanation: A near-death assessment is first promoted into actual death, creating an immediate contradiction.

findings.highlight: It’s telling me I’m wrong.
findings.evidenceJa: それは違うと。
findings.governingReading: It insists that this is wrong.
findings.explanation: The body rejects Archer’s claims and Shirou’s death; the English makes it accuse Shirou himself of being wrong.

findings.highlight: Not because of his attacks.
findings.evidenceJa: 瀑布の如きヤツの剣戟ではなく
findings.governingReading: not because of his waterfall-like barrage of sword blows
findings.explanation: The overwhelming waterfall image of Archer’s physical assault is omitted.

findings.highlight: how wrong I was
findings.evidenceJa: 破綻していると気づく間もなく
findings.governingReading: before I even had time to realize it was collapsing or internally broken
findings.explanation: Structural failure of the compulsive life pattern becomes moral wrongness.

findings.highlight: My body wants to succumb to the force of his attacks.
findings.evidenceJa: 体はとっくに、重撃に耐えられずリタイヤしたがっている。
findings.governingReading: My body has long since been unable to bear the heavy blows and is begging to retire.
findings.explanation: The duration and complete physical overload are reduced to a present desire to succumb.

findings.highlight: I frantically endure the attack coming down at me.
findings.evidenceJa: 無様に背中から瓦礫に落ちる一撃を、懸命に耐えきった。
findings.governingReading: He desperately withstands the blow that would send him falling ignominiously backward onto the rubble.
findings.explanation: The exact threatened fall and Shirou’s success in resisting it are omitted.

findings.highlight: drown in your ideals.
findings.evidenceJa: 抱いたまま溺死しろ
findings.governingReading: drown while still clutching that dream.
findings.explanation: Archer’s image of Shirou sinking while embracing the dream becomes the conventional metaphor of drowning in ideals.

findings.highlight: he isn’t even scratched.
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツは傷どころか呼吸さえ乱していない。
findings.governingReading: Archer is not merely unwounded; even his breathing is undisturbed.
findings.explanation: Archer’s untouched breathing, the immediate contrast with Shirou’s condition, is omitted.

findings.highlight: It is my mind that lost.
findings.evidenceJa: 負けていたのは、俺の心。
findings.governingReading: What had lost was my heart.
findings.explanation: The defeated heart is again changed into the mind, obscuring the section’s central heart-versus-body opposition.

findings.highlight: Becausemy body
findings.evidenceJa: なぜならずっとこの体は
findings.governingReading: Because my body
findings.explanation: Missing spacing fuses “Because” and “my.”

findings.highlight: A headache.
findings.evidenceJa: ぶつん、という頭痛。
findings.governingReading: A headache with a sharp snapping sensation.
findings.explanation: The abrupt snapping sensory cue is omitted.

findings.highlight: I see him
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツの風景を見た。
findings.governingReading: I saw his landscape or inner scene.
findings.explanation: A final glimpse of Archer’s internal landscape becomes simply seeing Archer.

findings.highlight: I guess I can use his pain as a lesson.
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みだけは教訓として知れたと思う。
findings.governingReading: I think I at least came to know the pain as a lesson.
findings.explanation: Receiving knowledge through pain becomes a claim that Shirou can instrumentally use Archer’s pain.

findings.highlight: A hero who used a poem about himself as his spell.
findings.evidenceJa: 自らを表す呪文に、自らを律する韻を持たせた英雄。
findings.governingReading: A hero who gave the spell expressing himself a rhyme by which to discipline himself.
findings.explanation: The incantation’s self-regulating rhyme and its purpose are omitted.

findings.highlight: I will defeat you with all my powers!
findings.evidenceJa: おまえという自分をうち負かす！
findings.governingReading: I will spend all my strength defeating the self that is you.
findings.explanation: The reciprocal selfhood at the heart of Shirou’s challenge is omitted.

findings.highlight: I swallow the blood clotting in my throat.
findings.evidenceJa: 喉につまった血の塊を飲み下す。
findings.governingReading: I swallow down the clot of blood lodged in my throat.
findings.explanation: A formed clot obstructing Shirou’s throat becomes blood currently clotting there.

findings.highlight: Yang-sword Kanshou regains its image.
findings.evidenceJa: 存在が稀薄だった陽剣干将が確かな実像を帯びていく。
findings.governingReading: The Yang sword Kanshou, whose existence had grown faint, takes on a firm, real form.
findings.explanation: Recovery of solid manifested existence is weakened to regaining an image.

findings.highlight: He believed that he would reach his destination if he kept running.
findings.evidenceJa: 走り続ければ、いつか、その地点に近づけると。
findings.governingReading: By continuing to run, he could someday draw closer to that point.
findings.explanation: The value of asymptotically approaching an unattainable ideal becomes eventual arrival.

findings.highlight: It is an unbelievable technique.
findings.evidenceJa: それは、ありえない剣戟だった。
findings.governingReading: It was an impossible exchange of sword blows.
findings.explanation: A sustained, mutually impossible duel becomes a singular technique.

findings.highlight: his limbs are slashed
findings.evidenceJa: 手足は裂かれ
findings.governingReading: his arms and legs are torn open
findings.explanation: The severity of Shirou’s bodily tearing is weakened to slashes.

findings.highlight: has now returned to fighting without them.
findings.evidenceJa: その様は元の少年に戻っている。
findings.governingReading: his outward manner has returned to that of the original boy.
findings.explanation: A visual and behavioral reversion despite retained knowledge becomes loss of the absorbed combat skills.

findings.highlight: An unskilled, frantic attack.
findings.evidenceJa: 出鱈目に振るわれた、あまりにも凡庸な一撃。
findings.governingReading: An all-too-ordinary blow swung haphazardly.
findings.explanation: The paradox of a technically ordinary blow carrying new weight becomes an unskilled frantic attack.

findings.highlight: Archer’s indifference turns into surprise within a second.
findings.evidenceJa: 放心は、秒を持たずに驚愕へと変わった。
findings.governingReading: His blank, stunned vacancy changes to astonishment in less than a second.
findings.explanation: A momentary stunned blankness becomes emotional indifference.

findings.highlight: The swinging swords are like a scream. crazy.
findings.evidenceJa: 奮われる剣は叫びのように。
findings.governingReading: The sword being swung is like a scream.
findings.explanation: The singular sword becomes plural, and the unsupported stray word “crazy” is left in the line.

findings.highlight: enough to cut off his limbs and to cut up his body to pieces!
findings.evidenceJa: この身を挽き潰すに有り余る！
findings.governingReading: more than enough to grind this body to pulp.
findings.explanation: The crushing or grinding force of the four blows is replaced by invented dismemberment detail.

findings.highlight: The boy loses his breath every time he attacks
findings.evidenceJa: 一撃放つ度に息があがり
findings.governingReading: The boy grows winded with every blow
findings.explanation: Exertional breathlessness is phrased as losing breath, confusing it with the earlier statement that breathing has stopped.

findings.highlight: why do those arms have seemingly infinite power?
findings.evidenceJa: 剣を振るうその手に、際限なく力が宿るのか。
findings.governingReading: why does limitless strength keep inhabiting the hand that swings the sword?
findings.explanation: The focal hand gripping and swinging the sword becomes both arms.

findings.highlight: I can’t be a superhero.
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方になんてなれないだろう。
findings.governingReading: I likely cannot become an ally of justice.
findings.explanation: The work’s central ideal-name is again replaced by “superhero.”

findings.highlight: he will fall forward and die if he retreats.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼が一歩下がるだけで前のめりに倒れ込み、死体となる。
findings.governingReading: if Archer takes a single step back, the blood-soaked boy will pitch forward and become a corpse.
findings.explanation: The retreat is reassigned from Archer to Shirou, reversing the tactical reason Archer can end the duel by yielding ground.

findings.highlight: the boy’s hands are one with the sword’s hilt.
findings.evidenceJa: 剣を握る両手は、とうに柄と一体化している。
findings.governingReading: both hands gripping the swords have already become one with their hilts.
findings.explanation: The paired hands, swords, and hilts are collapsed around a singular weapon.

findings.highlight: Even swinging the sword should come with great pain.
findings.evidenceJa: 振るう一撃は地獄の苦しみと同意の筈だ。
findings.governingReading: Each swung blow should be equivalent to the suffering of hell.
findings.explanation: The asserted equivalence to hellish suffering is weakened to great pain.

findings.highlight: There were people that could not save others, and there was me who could not save them.
findings.evidenceJa: 助けられなかった人たちと、助けられなかった自分がいる。
findings.governingReading: There are people I could not save, and the self who could not be saved.
findings.explanation: The victims become people unable to save others, while Shirou becomes the one who failed them instead of the self left unsaved.

findings.highlight: To become a superhero.
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方になる。
findings.governingReading: To become an ally of justice.
findings.explanation: The central ideal-name is again replaced by “superhero.”

findings.highlight: It has to come true…
findings.evidenceJa: 叶わないと。
findings.governingReading: “It cannot come true,”
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu’s sorrowful statement that the dream cannot be fulfilled is reversed into an imperative that it must come true.

findings.highlight: The person who saved me died, leaving those words behind.
findings.evidenceJa: 幼い頃、自分を救ってくれた人が寂しげに遺して逝った。
findings.governingReading: The person who saved me in childhood left those words sadly behind and died.
findings.explanation: Kiritsugu’s lonely, sorrowful manner and the childhood frame are omitted.

findings.highlight: Even if everyone in this world disagrees with me
findings.evidenceJa: 世界中の人間に疎まれても
findings.governingReading: Even if people throughout the world despise or shun me
findings.explanation: Social hatred and rejection are weakened to disagreement.

findings.highlight: Even if everyone in this world disagrees with me, and even if I myself curse me, I
findings.evidenceJa: 世界中の人間に疎まれても、こうして自分自身に呪われても、それだけは
findings.governingReading: Even if the whole world shuns me and my own self curses me, that alone—
findings.explanation: The English breaks off at the bare pronoun “I,” losing the Japanese fragment’s focus on preserving that one belief.

findings.highlight: He gasps.
findings.evidenceJa: 息が止まる。
findings.governingReading: His breath stops.
findings.explanation: A cessation of breath becomes an audible gasp.

findings.highlight: Looking straight at
findings.evidenceJa: まっすぐに、自分だけを
findings.governingReading: straight at him alone—
findings.explanation: The exclusive object of Shirou’s unwavering gaze, Archer himself, is omitted.

findings.highlight: wet my pants. I don’t have enough water. I can’t release excess things.
findings.evidenceJa: 水分が足りない。そんな余分な物は流せない。
findings.governingReading: There is too little fluid; I cannot shed anything so superfluous.
findings.explanation: mirror moon inserts the unsupported vulgar statement “wet my pants” into the pain sequence.

findings.highlight: wet my pants. I don’t have enough water. I can’t release excess things.
findings.evidenceJa: 水分が足りない。そんな余分な物は流せない。
findings.governingReading: There is too little bodily fluid to spill anything unnecessary.
findings.explanation: An invented interpretation is followed by two closer attempts, leaving three incompatible fragments in the displayed prose.

findings.highlight: This is my final blow.
findings.evidenceJa: それが、最後だった。
findings.governingReading: That was the last exchange.
findings.explanation: A narrator’s closure of the exchange becomes Shirou declaring the next action his final blow.

findings.highlight: shaking off everything
findings.evidenceJa: 胸を穿つ全てを振り切って
findings.governingReading: shaking free of everything that pierces his heart
findings.explanation: The heart-piercing character of the accusations Shirou breaks through is omitted.

findings.highlight: the sound of the blade piercing him.
findings.evidenceJa: 胸に刃物が突き刺さる音
findings.governingReading: the sound of a blade stabbing into his chest.
findings.explanation: The exact chest wound is generalized.

findings.highlight: The sword in my hand has pierced Archer’s chest.
findings.evidenceJa: 手にした干将は、確実にアーチャーの胸を貫いていた。
findings.governingReading: Kanshou in his hand has unmistakably pierced Archer’s chest.
findings.explanation: The named blade completing the duel is omitted.

findings.highlight: He might not need to answeror maybe
findings.evidenceJa: 答える必要がないと取ったのか、それとも
findings.governingReading: Perhaps he saw no need to answer, or perhaps
findings.explanation: Missing spacing fuses “answer” and “or.”

findings.highlight: “Yes. And I lost.”
findings.evidenceJa: 「ああ。そして、私の敗北だ」
findings.governingReading: “Yes. And this is my defeat.”
findings.explanation: The English does not reflect Archer’s marked shift from rough 俺 to formal 私 as he accepts defeat and addresses himself.
